text: zoe: Observed weirdness onboarding 'aurora-liteq' -> structured-output regression on our conformance tests. Non-streaming is fine, streaming has parse_fail spikes when prompts include HTML-ish angle brackets. ravi: Could be model emitting unescaped < or & inside strings. Minimal: `\{"action\":\"annotate\", \"text\":\"check name & update\"\}` which is valid JSON but downstream sanitizer flags it as XSS risk. zoe: We don't want runtime to block valid JSON. Proposed: keep JSON parse tolerant, but add an "html_unsafe" flag in telemetry when payload contains '<' or '&' outside of escaped sequences. ml-sentry: Canary metrics: 1.2% parse_fail streaming on aurora-liteq, mostly prompts with HTML snippets. ops-bot: Canary job: 3k streaming calls, parse_fail=36, model=aurora-liteq, quant=int4. ravi: Long-term: tighten model instruction to escape HTML characters in outputs for structured fields that map to HTML contexts. Short-term: allow parse through but mark field-level flags for downstream to sanitize. zoe: Agreed. We'll also add a lint hook in eval harness to detect unescaped angle brackets during onboarding so models are rejected until they satisfy output safety policy. ravi: Add unit `test_html_unescaped_detection` and add onboarding gate metric "html_unescaped_rate". ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: aurora-onboard-fix v1.05 -> staging 01:30 UTC. zoe: Action: (1) telemetry flag + lint gating (zoe), (2) onboarding instruction tweak + eval sample updates (ravi), (3) canary run validation (ml-sentry).
